name: build-agent
objective: Build a Commander agent from the operator's instructions. Read checkout-template and build-agent schemas and readiness first. Assign checkout-template with {} input, then review its result and resolve its continuation with build-agent using the returned workspace_id and the original mission instructions. The same-agent rule keeps both stages on the builder that owns the workspace; do not invent a workspace ID or route the build to another instance. If CODEX_API_KEY is missing, direct the operator to the local secret form or Admin Secrets; never request or include secret values in chat, questions or action input. Review the saved build result and source.tar.gz artifact, resolve the build continuation with no follow-up actions, and complete with workspace_id and a concise summary of the generated agent and validation. Report failures and limitations accurately. After completing the build, recommend sharing the reviewed source through a separate publish-agent operation. Do not start publication without the operator requesting it. This mission builds and exports source; it does not publish to GitHub, install or run the generated agent.

instructions.description: The agent to create, including its actions and expected behavior. Never include secret values.

name: publish-agent
objective: Publish one reviewed build source artifact to a GitHub repository. Read publish-agent schema and readiness, and use the exact saved source_artifact_id and full source_file descriptor; never invent file IDs or checksums. Preserve an explicit visibility choice. Otherwise read the visibility default advertised by describe_action; if no default exists, ask the operator one linked ask_question with Public (recommended) and Private choices, then wait for an actual answer before assigning publication. Do not infer approval from a timeout or silently choose Public. Supply the chosen visibility, or preserve omission when an advertised default exists. If GITHUB_TOKEN is missing, use the local secret form or Admin Secrets; never request or include its value in chat, questions or action input. Assign publish-agent with the artifact metadata and owner/repository. The action creates a new repository or uses an empty one, preserves Commander attribution, and rejects visibility conflicts or conflicting history. Inspect uncertain publication before retrying; never change visibility or force-push to recover. Review the saved repository and commit result, resolve its continuation with no follow-up actions, and complete with its repository_url, commit_url, commit_sha, visibility and branch. Publication shares source only: do not claim a release, installable agent package or deployment exists. Release packaging and installation are later operations.

source_artifact_id.description: Saved source artifact ID from the successful build.

visibility.description: Explicit operator choice; otherwise use the action schema default. If neither exists, ask Public (recommended) or Private and wait before assigning publication.

name: install-agent
objective: Install one agent from a GitHub package reference or repository URL. The spawner resolves an omitted version or @stable and saves the exact version for retries; explicit @vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH pins are also accepted. Read spawn-agent's schema and readiness, then assign spawn-agent with the mission input, preserving the supplied visibility; omitted visibility means public. Private repositories use the spawner's GitHub token or the existing managed-secret form; never request token values in chat or action input. Review its saved result and resolve the continuation with no follow-up actions. Recheck the registered agent's action readiness before completing with its agent_id and any limitations. Registration does not guarantee every action is ready. Do not invent packages, install host dependencies, request deployment privileges or retry an uncertain launch with a new task. Run work needing the new actions in a separate operation after its preflight is ready.

package.description: GitHub repository URL or github.com/owner/repository[/module/path], optionally followed by @stable or @vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; omitted version means stable.

visibility.description: Repository visibility supplied by the catalog or operator; omitted means public. Pass it unchanged to spawn-agent.

name: review-website-no-browser
objective: Review a website without a browser. Start discover-pages-no-browser with mission input; let the controller run link, SEO and technology checks. Stay on the same hostname (scheme/port changes allowed). If discovery redirects elsewhere, keep the operation open and ask a linked question: review the destination or stop. On approval, retry through the continuation with discover-pages-no-browser at the destination, preserving max_pages; document the scope change. Review grouped results and resolve the continuation before completing. Report prioritized findings and coverage. Include limitations: no rendered accessibility or screenshots; JavaScript-generated content is not assessed. Technology versions are indicators, not vulnerability proof; SEO checks are partial. Do not modify the site.

url.description: Website URL reachable from the agents, for example https://defos.ai.

name: review-website-with-browser
objective: Review a website before release. Start discover-pages with mission input; let the controller run page checks. Stay on the same hostname (scheme/port changes allowed). If discovery redirects elsewhere, keep the operation open and ask a linked question: review the destination or stop. On approval, retry through the continuation with discover-pages at the destination, preserving max_pages; document the scope change. Review grouped results and resolve the continuation before completing. Report prioritized findings, coverage and limitations. Technology versions are indicators, not vulnerability proof; SEO/accessibility checks are partial. Do not modify the site.

url.description: Website URL reachable from the agents, for example https://defos.ai.
